description: Land Title Settlement Department - Balalla, Mahawa D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 421591 (23/1200176)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels in the Kurunegala District under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership claims, cadastral maps, and the process for determining land titles, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3, and the specialized land focus makes it distinct from other specialized categories.
